items.title: Citi refines $1 trillion ‘sustainable finance’ pledge
items.summary: Citi has dedicated close to $650 billion to its goal of investing or lending $1 trillion in “sustainable finance” by 2030.

items.title: Sustainability professionals see a divide in how sustainability is viewed internally
items.summary: Recent GlobeScan and BSR research suggests that corporate sustainability may be facing an internal alignment challenge, with sector professionals perceiving a gap between the ways their teams and senior leaders view the role of sustainability within their organizations.

items.title: Why industrial-scale food waste processing is booming
items.summary: Data from a new facility for generating renewable natural gas shows how industrial-scale processing of food waste is experiencing a growth spurt.

items.title: Companies face $1.4trn carbon bill over next decade, says BNEF
items.summary: According to new analysis from BloombergNEF, as carbon markets mature, global companies could face $1.4trn in carbon price 'exposure' over the next 10 years.

items.title: What can the climate movement learn from the student protests in India?
items.summary: The climate movement does not have an apathy problem. It has a communication and culture problem.

items.title: Platform Housing Group unveils roadmap to 2050 net-zero value chain
items.summary: Non-profit housing association Platform has launched the next phase of its plan to reach net-zero greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 2050.

items.title: VodafoneThree seeks UK-based carbon removal projects
items.summary: VodafoneThree has opened a request for proposals (RFP) for UK-based carbon removal projects to account for 24,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent.

items.summary: Olive oil’s rising prices are more than a cost-of-living story.

items.title: COP17 on desertification: Everything you need to know
items.summary: The 17th Conference of the Parties (COP17) to the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) commences on Monday 17 August.
